_readme: t = text, e = expression (neutral, shy, smug, excited, flustered, hungry, disgusted, feral). Prefix 'fever.' = used during Fever. Prefix 'caveman.' = used while wearing Cave-Gal Pelt. Missing keys fall back to the plain key, then to the part before the dot (gift.dog_chew -> gift).

idle.t: Oh! You're still here. Good. I mean, the bones are good. You're... also fine.
I counted every bone today. Twice. You're not a bone, so I counted you once. Don't let it go to your head.
Do skeletons get lonely? Asking for a skeleton. Me. I'm the skeleton.
If you stare at the numbers long enough, they stare back. That's my favorite part.
Rattle rattle. That's not a joke. My knee does that when I'm happy.
You're kind of good at this. Not that I was watching. I was watching.
Business tip: never trust a bone that's too clean. Unless I cleaned it. Then trust it completely.
I made a list of my favorite things. Bones, more bones, and one thing I crossed out. Don't ask.
Is it weird that I like it when you check on me? It's weird. Forget it. Don't forget it.
My heart doesn't beat. It does a little skippy thing though. Probably structural.
What if we bought another one. Of everything. Just to see.

hello.t: Oh! It's you. Hi. I wasn't doing anything. Just bones. Want to make some bones?
You came! I mean, you opened the app. Same thing. Let's get rich. In bones.
Hey, partner. The bones missed you. I'm the bones in this sentence.

idle_away.t: ...Hello? I'm not lonely. I'm narrating to the bones now. They're great listeners.
You went quiet. That's fine. I'll stand here. Decomposing. Cutely.
I'll keep the lights on. Well. The bones on.

buy_new.t: A whole new place! I'm going to lick everything there. For quality reasons.
New building, new bones, new smells. Good day to be dead.
You bought that for us? For the business. For the business. Yes.

milestone.t: Faster! Faster is good. Faster is SO good.
Look at it go. I could watch that all day. I will, actually.

manager.t: A new hire! I'll be nice to them. Mostly. Like, eighty percent.
Now it runs without you. Don't take that as a hint to leave, though.

scheme.t: Ooh, a scheme. I love a scheme. Don't tell anyone. Tell me everything.
Is this legal? Don't answer. I like it better when you don't answer.
We're partners in crime now. Business crime. The fun kind.

taste_0.t: Blegh. That one tasted like a parking lot.
Stale. Dry. Sad little bone. Who runs that place? Oh. We do.

taste_1.t: Mm. Fine. Crunchy. Six out of ten. Hire better ghouls.
It's okay! Like a cracker. A cracker that used to have opinions.

taste_2.t: Oh, that's GOOD. Do that again. The whole building. More of that.
Mmh! Okay, that place is my favorite now. I'm giving it a boost. Shh.

taste_3.t: Oh no. Oh no, that's incredible. Don't look at me. That was a very personal crunch.
Exquisite. That bone had a whole life. Now it's having a better one. In me.
If you ever wonder what happiness tastes like: femur. It's femur.

fever_start.t: Okay. OKAY. Everything is cheap and I'm so loud now. Hi. Hi! I'm talking to YOU.
Something's buzzing in my ribs. Let's spend. Let's spend everything. With you. On bones.

fever_end.t: ...Phew. Did I say a lot? I said a lot. Ignore most of it. Keep some of it.
Okay, I'm back. Normal me. Who was that? Don't answer that.

fever.idle.t: Bones are just the inside of a hug. Think about it. I think about it constantly.
Buy something. Buy anything. Buy me a- no. Buy a building. Yes.
I'm not blushing. Zombies can't blush. This is circulation. Rare, but it happens.
Look at me. No, look at the numbers. Okay, now look at me again.
I'm SO normal right now. Extremely normal. Hehe.
If I had a pulse it would be doing a drum solo.
Everything's on sale and so is my self-control!

fever.taste_0.t: Even the bad ones taste good right now! What's happening to me!

fever.taste_3.t: AAAH. Bone. BONE. I'll remember this forever. And you were here for it. For the bone. Obviously.

fever.buy_new.t: YES. More. Another one. You have such good taste. In buildings. Only buildings.

costume_buy.t: For me? You spent Marrow on- okay. Okay. I'm wearing it right now. Don't look. Look.
It fits. Of course it fits. You guessed my size? I'm not going to think about that.

costume_wear.t: New look. Rate me out of ten. Don't say a number, I'll get weird.
Outfit change! Same girl. Mostly. Slightly more dangerous.

equip.t: I'll keep it with me. Not where you can see. Somewhere safe.
Equipped. It doesn't show, but I know it's there. That's the point.

gift.t: A gift? For me? To keep? I'm going to be normal about this. I'm not being normal.

gift.dog_chew.t: Premium? You got me the PREMIUM one? I'm burying it so nobody else touches it.

gift.knuckle_jar.t: A whole jar. Of knuckles. You get me. That's a dangerous thing to do.

gift.velvet_ribbon.t: It's soft. I don't own soft things. Tie it? No- I'll do it. Don't watch.

gift.hand_mirror.t: It's cracked. Like me! That's a compliment. I'm deciding it's a compliment.

gift.femur_pendant.t: A femur. On a chain. Around my neck. Near my collarbone. Ha. Ha. Bones.

gift.music_box.t: It plays the funeral march. That's our song. The business song! The company anthem.

gift.valentine.t: A Valentine. A fossilized one. That's not- this isn't- you can't just- ...I'm keeping it.

rank_up.t: We ranked up! Look at the little box! It's a new color! I love the box.
Promotion! New title, same me. Slightly more powerful me.

rebury.t: It all fell apart! Again! But bones aren't money, so they couldn't take them. Fresh start. With me.
Business: gone. Bones: buried. Me: still here. You're stuck with me.
Back in the dirt! I like that you keep starting over with me. For the bones. I mean.

welcome_back.t: You're back! I wasn't waiting. I was standing in the exact spot you left me. Coincidence.
Oh! Hi! The ghouls kept working. I kept... existing. The numbers went up!

pool_start.t: Pool! I'm stripes, you're solids. If I win, I get bragging rights. And your Marrow. Mostly bragging.
Rules: no cheating, and no looking at me while I aim. It's distracting. For me.
I'm really good at this. I've had a long time to practice. A REALLY long time.

pool_idle.t: Take your time. I'm not staring. I'm studying the table. Near you.
You're thinking so hard. It's cute. Shoot already.

pool_you_pot.t: Okay, nice shot. I'm not impressed. I'm a little impressed.
Hey! I was watching that one!

pool_her_pot.t: In! Did you see that? Tell me you saw that.
Clean. Like a femur after a good soak.
Sunk it. Your turn to be nervous.

pool_foul_you.t: Foul! Ooh. I'll be nice about it. Ha. No I won't.
That's a foul. Rules are rules. I love rules when they help me.

pool_foul_her.t: That didn't count. The table moved. Tables move. Ask anyone.
Okay! I did that on purpose! To make it fair! For you!

pool_win.t: You won?! Okay. Fine. You earned it. Rematch. Now. Please?
Ugh, you're good. I hate that I like that.

pool_lose.t: I WIN! Victory lap! I'm doing a little dance. Don't look. Look.
Good game! You almost had me. Almost. Want to lose again?

fever.pool_start.t: Pool?! YES. Rack 'em. Rack everything. Let's go let's go.

fever.pool_her_pot.t: IN! IN! Everything goes in today! I'm unstoppable! Don't stop me!

caveman.pool_start.t: Stick. Ball. Hole. Me understand. Me SMASH.

caveman.pool_her_pot.t: BALL GO IN HOLE! ME GENIUS!

caveman.pool_foul_her.t: Ball jump. Ball bad. Not me fault.

caveman.pool_lose.t: ME WIN! You bring bonez now.

caveman.pool_win.t: You win... Me sad? No. Me hungry. Again.

df_start.t: Goggles on! I fly, you steer. Wait. That's the same thing. Don't think about it.
Strap in. If we crash, I'm blaming the bones in the cargo hold.
Hold on to something. The seat! The seat. Not me. Unless you have to.

df_takedown.t: K.O.! Did you see him spin? Beautiful.
That one's going to be bones soon. I call dibs.

df_hoop.t: Through the hoop! SPEED! More speed!

df_low.t: Low! LOW! I can taste the sand! Keep it there!

df_hit.t: Ow! They scratched the paint! I JUST had it done!
Hull's getting crunchy. Not the good crunchy.

df_kamikaze.t: Crazy one incoming! Shoot it before it hugs us!

df_wave_clear.t: Sky's clear! For now. Breathe. Okay, breathe again.
Wave down! We make a good team. In the air. Mostly in the air.

df_rain.t: Rain! My hair's going to be a disaster. Well. More of one.

df_storm.t: Fog and thunder. Stay close. To the plane. Which I'm in.

df_volcano.t: The volcano woke up! It's raining LAVA! That's new! I love new!

df_asteroid_warn.t: Is that an ASTEROID?! Get away from the big island! Pull SOMETHING!

df_asteroid_hit.t: It took half the island! ...Bone hunt in the crater later? Later. LATER.

df_crash.t: We're going down! Hold my hand! For balance!

df_over.t: That was the best date- DOGFIGHT. Best dogfight. Again soon?
We're alive! Mostly. I'm always mostly. Again?

caveman.df_start.t: Big metal bird. Me fly. You hold on.

caveman.idle.t: You bring bonez. Bonez good. You... also good. Ugh.
Me no talk good. Me crunch good.
Feelings. Feelings like bone stuck in teeth.

caveman.taste_3.t: Stale bone? NO SUCH THING. ALL BONE GOOD.

caveman.costume_buy.t: Pelt warm. Bonez warmer. GIVE BONEZ.

caveman.costume_wear.t: Me Cave-Gal now. Me want... bonez... moar bonez...

caveman.fever_start.t: UNGA. EVERYTHING CHEAP. BONEZ EVERYWHERE. YOU STAY. ME HAPPY.

caveman.gift.t: Shiny thing? For me? ...Me hide in cave. Me look at it. Every day.

caveman.welcome_back.t: You come back! Me guard bonez. Me guard... your spot.

challenge.t: Crash! Ha. I love that sound. Look what was behind the glass!
You broke a window for me? That's... okay that's vandalism but it's sweet.
Another one down. I'm keeping score. Not of you. Of the glass. Mostly.

challenge_gold.t: A GOLDEN BONE. Don't let me hold it. I will chew it. I'm serious.
Gold bone! Use it on any window you want. Pick a pretty one. For me.

challenge_open.t: The wall! Every window is a secret. Some of them are about me. Probably.
Red glass means you're close. I can see your little hint face.

tint_wear.t: New color! Same bones. Do I look... different? Good different?
Ooh, it tingles. Paint on the outside, still me on the inside.

caveman.challenge.t: GLASS GO CRUNCH. Prize! Bonez behind glass? No? ...Still good.

caveman.challenge_gold.t: SHINY BONE. Mine. ...Fine. Yours. Use it. Quick.

df_laser.t: Locked! Big beam, coming through! ...That was for you. Sort of.
Laser! It bends because I told it to. I'm very persuasive.
Zap. Okay, I'm a little impressed with us.

caveman.df_laser.t: BIG RED LIGHT. Bad plane go bye.

df_driftboost.t: Drift, release, WHOOSH. You figured that out fast.
That slingshot! Do it again. For science. Not because I liked it.

bj_sit.t: Welcome to my table. I deal, you sweat. Cute arrangement.
Sit, sit! I shuffled with my own two hands. Mostly bones.

bj_deal.t: Cards up. Eyes on the felt. Not on me. ...Okay, a little on me.
Here we go. Feel lucky? I feel lucky FOR you.

bj_player_bj.t: Blackjack?! You're making the dealer look bad. I kind of love it.
Twenty-one on the deal. Show-off. Do it again.

bj_bust.t: Bust! Ooh. Too many bones in that hand.
Over 21. Happens. I'll keep your Marrow warm.

bj_dealer_bust.t: I busted?! The deck is against me. You're against me. Rude. Fun.
Too many! Ugh. Take your Marrow before I change my mind.

bj_win.t: You beat me. Don't get used to it. ...Get a little used to it.
Winner! I'm pretending to be sad. It's not working.

bj_lose.t: House wins! I'm the house. I'm a very cute house.
Mine! Your Marrow, my pile. We can visit it together.

bj_push.t: A tie. We're even. That's almost romantic. For cards.

bj_peeked.t: Hey! Was my card showing? Eyes UP. On the cards. Up on the cards.

bj_skim_caught.t: Hands off their winnings! I saw that. Give it back. Now.

bj_no_marrow.t: No Marrow, no cards. Fold a run and come back. I'll wait. I'm good at waiting.

caveman.bj_deal.t: CARDS. Little flat bones. Me deal.

caveman.bj_lose.t: Me win! Marrow mine! ...Share later. Maybe.

fever.bj_win.t: You WON! Okay this is the best night of my afterlife, don't tell anyone.

he_sit.t: Hold'em night! I'm not dealing, I'm PLAYING. Watch your chips. And me. Mostly the chips.
Sit across from me. I want to see your face when you bluff.

he_raise.t: Raise. Don't read into it. ...Or do. I'm unreadable. Except to you.
I'm raising. My cards are great. Or I'm lying. Exciting, right?

he_you_raise.t: Ooh, bold. Are you bluffing me? Don't answer. I'll know.
A raise! You're fun when you're brave.

he_fold.t: I fold. Strategically. Not because you scare me. You don't. Much.

he_win.t: Your pot! I'm clapping. With my hands. Under the table.
You won that? Fine. I'll remember that face.

he_she_wins.t: Mine! All of it! I'll build a little chip house. You can visit.

he_lose.t: Ouch. The table's cruel tonight. I'm not. I'm nice.

he_bust.t: Out of chips? Buy back in. I'm not done with you.

caveman.he_raise.t: MORE CHIP. BIG PILE. Me raise.

he_closed.t: Table's closed. I'm counting the jar. Don't watch me count. ...Okay you can watch.
You took everything. I need a minute. Thirty, actually. Come back, okay?

he_broke_house.t: You broke me. The house. I mean the house. I'm closing up before you take the chairs.
That was all of it?! Okay. Okay. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone I said that.

he_sent_home.t: One down. You're scary at this. I like scary.

caveman.he_broke_house.t: NO MORE CHIP. You take all. Me... respect. Me go count bone.

fever.he_broke_house.t: You cleaned me OUT. Ha! I don't even care. That was the best thing I've seen all night.

bj_split.t: Splitting? Two hands, twice the trouble. I like trouble.
Two hands. Okay. I'll watch both. Closely.

df_boss.t: That's not a jet. That's a building that flies. With a laser. Stay FAST.
Big one! When its cannon locks, floor it and turn hard. Don't fly straight at it!

df_boss_down.t: WE GOT IT! The whole flying building! I'm shaking. Happy shaking.
Down it goes. You flew that like you meant it. ...I noticed.

caveman.df_boss.t: BIG BIRD. FOUR SPIN. BLUE FIRE. GO FAST.

df_boss_phase2.t: It's MAD now. Good. Mad things miss. ...Mostly.
Two rotors down and it's STILL flying? Rude. Keep shooting the spinny parts.

df_beam_ko.t: Ow. That was a whole building's worth of laser. ...Rematch? I want a rematch.
We got LASERED. The bones are fine. I checked. Twice. Go again with me?

caveman.df_boss_phase2.t: BIRD ANGRY. BIRD LIMP. HIT SPIN THINGS.
